headline: Restrictive, and the market has all but locked in a December hike: FedWatch odds sit near 95% after October retail sales beat ex-autos, even as a tech sell-off nudged the 10-year back to 5.10% and the 2-year to 4.79%. Spreads remain contained (HY ~323 bp) and oil steadied around $86 WTI, but the dollar is pinned near a 19-month high. Keep underwriting to a 10-year above 5% and floating-rate costs 25 bp higher after Dec 9; use any haven-driven dip in yields to lock fixed-rate financing.
